Device is USB-powered and always on in v1: no deep sleep, no OTA, no NTP (the host formats every time string). Architecture (pense-bem convention, founder's habit): `firmware/src/usage/` is pure C++17 with NO Arduino/M5 headers (ArduinoJson single header allowed — it is platform-independent); ONLY `firmware/src/hal/sticks3/*.cpp|*.h` and `firmware/src/main.cpp` may include <M5Unified.h>/<Arduino.h>/<WiFi.h>/<HTTPClient.h>; no `delay()` inside logic; no heap allocation in the per-loop path (bounded char arrays); every stateful piece is an explicit state machine polled with `update(nowMs)`; the renderer diffs (by rev) and pushes. Vendor ArduinoJson as ONE header: download `https://github.com/bblanchon/ArduinoJson/releases/download/v7.4.2/ArduinoJson-v7.4.2.h` to `firmware/third_party/ArduinoJson.h` (keep its MIT licence header; add `firmware/third_party/LICENSE-ArduinoJson.txt`). Create `firmware/test/host/framework.h`: a ~100-line header-only harness modelled on /Users/fcavalcanti/dev/pense-bem-cardputer-adv/test/host/framework.h (read it): `TEST(name)` registration, `ASSERT_TRUE/ASSERT_EQ/ASSERT_STREQ`, a failing assertion throws, `main` prints `PASS <name>` per test and a summary ending in `Failed N`. Add `firmware/test/host/test_smoke.cpp` with one test that parses `{"v":1}` with ArduinoJson on the host (`#define ARDUINOJSON_ENABLE_ARDUINO_STRING 0` etc. as needed) and asserts `doc["v"] == 1`. ORDER #29: USB-insert ext0 wake via PM1 GPIO1 IRQ is DISABLED — driving PM1 GPIO1 push-pull conflicts with the SDA line and hangs PMIC I2C reads after wake (see docs/DEVICES.md). Wake sources are ext1 buttons only (BtnA GPIO11, BtnB GPIO12, ESP_EXT1_WAKEUP_ANY_LOW with pullup_en + pulldown_dis on each) plus a 60 s timer backstop (not 3600 s) so a USB cable insert is noticed within a minute.
